obfuscation_indicators: continued ability to capitalize on opportunities
risk_summary: The disclosure is highly quantified and provides reconciliations for major operating and cash-flow measures, supporting relatively strong transparency. Governance instability, leadership turnover, legal proceedings, and increased content investment present meaningful risks, although reported revenue, earnings, and cash flow trends are generally favorable. Reliance on adjusted non-GAAP metrics and numerous discrete-item explanations somewhat complicates assessment of underlying performance.
